'''Nogometni Klub Primorac 1929''' ({{langx|en|Football Club Primorac 1929}}), commonly referred to as '''Primorac Stobreč''', is a [[Croatia]]n [[Association football|football]] club based in the small coastal town of [[Stobreč]] near the city of [[Split, Croatia|Split]] in central [[Dalmatia]]. They are members of the [[3. HNL]] South, one of five third level divisions in the [[Croatian football league system]]. Primorac 1929 acted as a [[farm team]] for the nearby powerhouse [[HNK Hajduk Split|Hajduk Split]] from 2011 to 2014."}}
